decision: B: isolation antechamber at the refuge end of the gallery. Both closures are pressure-seated in opposite directions, so 80 kPa either way seats a leaf instead of loading dogs; each leaf has an equalisation valve and manual override operable from both sides. It keeps the refuge sealed and its shielding closed in every studied single fault, at 509 kg against 140 kg; a jam of either leaf still leaves the trunk exit.
